title: Schedule history entry (one line of a schedule's history)
description: profiles/<slug>/schedules/<id>.history.jsonl: one compact JSON object per line, appended by Store.appendScheduleHistory (src/core/store.ts) from src/schedules/scheduler.ts (fired, skipped, error, edited) and src/board/board-tickets.ts (quiet). Type ScheduleHistoryEntry in src/core/types.ts, a union by kind. The first line of a new schedule is an edited entry with action created and fields []. The file grows for years and is read paged from the end. Unknown fields must be kept.

trigger.description: ScheduleTrigger: its cron time, a time missed while the computer was off, or Run now.

ticketId.description: The ticket whose board run asked for it.

fired.description: The schedule created its ticket and started it.

note.description: Why the run went somewhere else than the schedule says (e.g. its feature is gone, so it got its own card).

by.description: A manual run only: the ticket whose board run asked for it; missing when the user did.

skipped.description: Not fired: skipIfRunning and its previous ticket (ticketId) was still queued or running.

error.description: The fire could not create its ticket.

quiet.description: A quiet schedule's run found nothing for the user: the board removed its ticket (ticketId, now gone).

summary.description: The run's summary, cut to 500 chars.

edited.description: The schedule was created, changed, paused or resumed.

fields.description: Names of the Schedule fields that changed; [] for created.

by.description: ScheduleEditor: the user (board UI, CLI, Claude outside a run) or the board run of a ticket.

previous.description: Updated only, and only when one of these changed: their old values, so a bad edit can be undone.
